name: adv_domain_fluid_mechanical_rejected
source:
// Fluid port (P, mdot, h) connected to a rotational mechanical port must fail.
Source     SRC(f1, fluid$ = Water, mdot = 1.0, P = 100000, T = 300)
Inertia    J1(m1, J = 0.5, w0 = 0)
connect(SRC.out, J1.port)
w = J1.port.w

error.message: connect(src.out, j1.port): cannot connect a fluid port (src.out) to a mechanical port (j1.port) — different physical domains. Couple domains through a transducer component (a motor, pump, heating resistor, …), not a direct connect.
